newsitem.title: USA: Connaught Labs says FDA clears vaccine.
newsitem.headline: Connaught Labs says FDA clears vaccine.

text.p: Connaught Laboratories Inc said on Monday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved a vaccine combining a Haemophilus vaccine with an acellular pertussis vaccine.

The vaccine was approved for the fourth dose in the childhood immunization series, which is administered between 15 and 18 months of age, the company said. The two vaccines are ActHIB Haemophilus b conjugate vaccine (tetanus toxoid conjugate) and Tripedia (diphtheria and tetanus toxoids and acellular pertussis vaccine adsorbed).
Connaught is part of Rhone-Poulenc SA.
